section_summary.extract_value: This Results section presents descriptive statistics and inter-item correlations in Table 1, noting that consideration of cosmetic surgery correlated positively with several SATAQ-3 subscales and negatively with body appreciation, BMI, and age. A multiple linear regression (F(7, 314) = 41.89, Adj. R^2 = .471) identified significant predictors of consideration of cosmetic surgery: body appreciation, Internalisation-General, Information, BMI, and Pressures. The section does not label any studies (no 'Study 1' or similar) or report participant recruitment source or country.
